rules.name: README present
rules.remediation: Add a README.md at the repository root.

rules.name: LICENSE present
rules.remediation: Add an OSI-approved LICENSE at the repository root (https://choosealicense.com).

rules.name: LICENSE matches a recognised SPDX license
rules.remediation: Use a verbatim SPDX license text from https://spdx.org/licenses/ for tooling compatibility.

rules.name: .gitignore present
rules.remediation: Start from a curated template at https://github.com/github/gitignore.

rules.name: .gitattributes contains EOL normalisation
rules.remediation: Add `* text=auto` near the top of .gitattributes for cross-platform line endings.

rules.name: .editorconfig present
rules.remediation: Add an .editorconfig — see https://editorconfig.org for the syntax.
